# Vendored copy of Shaka Player

Source: https://github.com/shaka-project/shaka-player, npm package shaka-player 5.2.12
(`dist/shaka-player.compiled.js`), unmodified. Licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

It plays copy-protected lectures with the browser engine's Widevine module, see
`src/protectedplayer.js`.
